title: JetBrains/junie
description: An AI coding agent by JetBrains that ships code from your terminal, IDE, or CI/CD pipeline - powered by any LLM you choose

title: vstorm-co/summarization-pydantic-ai
description: Context Management processor for Pydantic AI agents, providing LLM-powered summarization or zero-cost sliding window trimming to handle infinite/long-running conversations without context overflow. Supports flexible triggers, safe cutoffs, and custom prompts for efficient AI apps.

title: tjpoisal/UNIMATRIX
description: Unimatrix is a cloud-native AI memory system that gives any LLM instant, persistent context across devices and sessions. Dual-layer mem, hybrid retrieval w/ recency decay, a Librarian agent, and enterprise encryption.

title: Osmantic/ODS
description: Turn your PC, Mac, or Linux box into an AI server.  LLM inference, chat UI, voice, agents, workflows, RAG, and image generation.

title: bgill55/daedalus
description: Daedalus is a standalone terminal-based AI coding assistant that runs on your machine. It connects to local LLM servers (LM Studio, Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM) or remote providers (OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Anthropic), routes requests intelligently, and gives your AI agent access to your file system, terminal, git, web search, and codebase indexing

title: Mesh-LLM/mesh-llm
description: Distributed AI/LLM for the people. Share compute privately or publicly to power your agents and chat.

title: artokun/comfyui-mcp-panel
description: The local-first sidebar AI agent for ComfyUI — runs on your own Claude OR ChatGPT subscription (no API keys, no extra LLM costs). Drives your live graph: edits, workflows & installs in natural language. The panel UI for comfyui-mcp, the agent-native control plane for ComfyUI.

title: mockagents/mockagents
description: Simulate, test, and validate AI agent integrations — without calling real LLMs or burning tokens.

title: SECBLOK/belay
description: AIDefender is a local security layer that sits at the tool-call boundary of your AI coding agents. title: XAIHT/Tlamatini
description: Tlamatini is a self-hosted AI developer assistant for local or cloud LLMs: hybrid RAG over your codebase, a 79-tool multi-turn engine, a 74-agent visual workflow designer, and ACPX, a runtime for external coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor and Gemini CLI.

title: bystray/gonka-mcp-server
description: MCP server for the GONKA network: run cheap LLM inference through the server (free trial or your own key), get multi-model second opinions, and compare live prices — for any AI agent.

title: shrihan-vijay/promptchameleon
description: Chrome extension that adapts your prompt to whichever LLM you're using (Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini) via a two-step AI agent pipeline.

title: silbaram/pulse-agent
description: An LLM-powered AI Ops agent that monitors application health, diagnoses error logs across any tech stack, and automates self-healing or developer-approved recovery.

title: lorisunjunbin/petp
description: Python RPA toolkit with 80+ processors orchestrating browser automation, AI/LLM (10 providers), databases, SSH, email, and HTTP tasks. Configurable pipelines with cron scheduling and loops. Runs as wxPython GUI, headless service, or  Docker container. Built-in MCP Tool Server (Streamable-HTTP) for AI agent integration.

title: aotuai/structured-vibe-coding
description: A CLI tool and methodology for bare-metal LLM control. Generate production code using Claude, Gemini, and GPT without relying on Cursor, Codex, or autonomous agents. Maintain total control over your AI spend—whether your budget is $20 or $200 a month. Built for veteran engineers.

title: lucasmailland/mnemosyne
description: Cognitive memory for AI agents. Bitemporal, multi-tenant Postgres + pgvector. Hybrid recall (BM25 + vectors + graph) with BYO LLM. Use as a library, HTTP API, or MCP server.

title: HectorPulido/godot-ai-bindings
description: AI bindings for the Godot engine: connect your game to a Llama LLM through websockets, or train agents with reinforcement learning from Python

title: jdorner/palim
description: Self-hosted AI agent platform with extensions, workflows, and a web UI. Local LLM inference via llama.cpp (or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint).

title: udaykanthr/agentchanti
description: Autonomous multi-agent AI coding CLI & Python library with built-in RAG. Plans, codes, reviews, tests — works with local LLMs (Ollama, LM Studio) or cloud (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude).

title: teflon07/memkeeper
description: Local-first, deterministic memory store for AI agents: SQLite-backed BM25 with optional local ONNX semantic search and cross-encoder rerank, graph projection, and an MCP adapter. No required network or LLM.
